paras: Sceloporus goldmani, also known commonly as Goldman's bunchgrass lizard and la lagartija de pastizal de Goldman in Mexican Spanish, is a species of lizard in the family Phrynosomatidae. The species is endemic to Mexico.
The specific name, goldmani, is in honor of American zoologist Edward Alphonso Goldman.
S. goldmani is found in the Mexican states of Coahuila and San Luis Potosí.
The preferred natural habitat of S. goldmani is grassland, at altitudes of 1,600–2,200 m (5,200–7,200 ft).
The mode of reproduction of S. goldmani has been described as viviparous and as ovoviviparous.
